skill_name: Read the following text and identify which grammar rules were violated.
workflow: In this sentence, the grammar rules that were violated are the plural subject-verb agreement and the indefinite article usage. The subject of the sentence is "two dog", which should be "two dogs". Additionally, the indefinite article "a" should be used before a word beginning with a consonant, whereas in this case the subject is a word beginning with a vowel ("cat"), and so the article should be "an".
